notes.title: Update description of "sword and peach blossom" game on July 30
notes.content:
[b] Dear players, I'm very sorry. Due to our limited technical power, we have caused you an unpleasant game experience. I feel deeply sorry for this.

Fortunately, the technical support of Liu, the programmer(also the composer of this game), helped us modify the relevant bugs, modify some typos, and dialog box display problems, and add music appreciation that we didn't have before.

At present, the game patch has been made. Now upload the new version of the game to steam. Subsequent players will not be affected by bugs, and previous players can also download and play again.

In addition, since this game does not support 32-bit system, if there are players who cannot download and play after purchase, you can add Q community: 498313734[/b]

tags.feature: add music appreciation that we didn't have before

notes.title: Announcement that the game "sword and peachblossom" will to update
notes.content:
[b]  Hello, players. We are very sorry for your unpleasant experience of playing this game. Previously, due to our lack of technical power, we couldn't modify the save / read file UI that reflected more, and there were related bugs.     
       Fortunately, now that we have found programmers who are willing to help us, we will try our best to correct the related problems and bugs that have a bad experience of playing this game.      
      In addition, we will also add the music appreciation function that has not been put into the game before, so that players can better experience the game.      
     We also welcome players to join the Q group of this game to share and report bugs and bad experiences when playing the game. We will try our best to correct the problems.[/b]
QQ ：498313734[/b]
